msg: goal: Start opening a new Share Savings sub-account for member [goal_id] with a $25.00 initial deposit, nickname 'Vacation', funded from the existing share draft, and get as far as the confirmation review screen. Do NOT submit it.
Open the sub-account workflow to begin the requested Share Savings application.
Select the requested Share Savings account type.
Enter the requested initial deposit amount.
Enter the requested nickname for the new Share Savings sub-account.
Select the requested existing share draft funding source.
Tick the required member consent and disclosures checkbox so the application can proceed to the review screen.
Continue to the review screen without submitting the new sub-account.
The confirmation review screen is displayed with all requested details, and the irreversible Confirm and Submit action was not selected.
